Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. BlueBay's security team wants a short-run staging validation before we kick off production VPC peering. I've attached our initial manifest (bluebay-telemetry-manifest.pdf) with the log types and retention expectations. Can your team provide a staging-proxy config we can vet and a checklist for evidence we can sign off on? We aim to start the staging window 2028-03-20.

Best,

Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Telemetry staging proxy — next steps and manifest

Ingrid / Cascadia team —

Summary and action items from our runbook draft:

1) Forwarding path: Redwood will run a staging-proxy (container) in your staging VPC that accepts telemetry over TLS (port 6514) and can forward either: a) HTTPS to your Splunk HEC endpoint with mutual TLS, or b) S3 archive + signed bundle for evidence. BlueBay asked for direct HEC -> we've built TLS client auth into the proxy; sample client cert rotation is in the runbook.

2) Chain-of-custody: each export bundle = gzipped file named <account>_<ts>_<seq>.tgz with a companion .sha256 and a .sig. By default Redwood will HMAC the .sha256 using a per-customer key stored in our KMS; if you require PGP we can produce a PGP-signed bundle instead. Example header:

-----BEGIN CUSTODy BUNDLE-----
account: bluebay
filename: bluebay_20280320T150012Z_0001.tgz
hash: e3b0c44298fc1c14... (SHA256)
signed-by: redwood-kms:key-09
-----END CUSTODY BUNDLE-----

3) Tracing hooks: we'll emit spans with name pattern redwood.server.<route> and tags: deployment_id, model_id, request_id. We'll provide a small mapping table for your SIEM/APM team during the staging window.

4) Evidence handoff: Marissa will send the completed spreadsheet and our signed manifest sample by EOD tomorrow. Ben will deliver the proxy container image and sample config (staging-proxy-config.yaml) to your staging cluster.

Questions for BlueBay / Cascadia:
- Preferred signature mechanism (HMAC by KMS vs PGP)?
- Any additional required metadata fields in the bundle for your evidence locker?

I'll open a short-lived drive folder with the artifacts and the runbook link: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/priya/bluebay-telemetry-manifest

Thanks all — Priya
